info.title: PolyCafe administrative CRUD API
info.description: Schema observed on Supabase PolyCafe. Session authentication and X-CSRF-TOKEN required. Administrative endpoints require global owner/sysadmin. Writes obey SRS lifecycle; append-only tables reject PATCH/DELETE. Schema fields do not override server-owned field restrictions.
